title: The Service Charge on In-Room Dining Raised During a Resort Lodging Stay
content:
A service charge is added on what a Resort Lodging party had brought to the unit, worked out on the incidental charges the folio carries for the stay raised at the in-room dining outlet. Whether the household holds a dining plan under Mountain Dining Plans standing active for the season of the stay decides the share.

Where the folio carries incidental charges raised at the in-room dining outlet for the stay and a dining plan stands active for the season of the stay, the member service share of those charges is added, being 12 percent of them.

Where the folio carries incidental charges raised at the in-room dining outlet for the stay and no dining plan stands active for that season, the standard service share of those charges is added, being 18 percent of them.

Where the folio carries no charge raised at that outlet, nothing is added.

| Charges on the folio from the in-room dining outlet | Dining plan standing active for the season | Added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 12 percent of those charges |
| yes | no | 18 percent of those charges |
| no | either | nothing |

### Three hypothetical folios

A folio carrying 300.00 USD of incidental charges raised at the in-room dining outlet, on a household holding a dining plan standing active for the season of the stay, has 36.00 USD added, being 12 percent of 300.00 USD.

The same folio, on a household with no dining plan standing active for that season, has 54.00 USD added, being 18 percent of 300.00 USD.

A folio carrying no charge raised at that outlet has nothing added, whether or not a dining plan stands active.
